bio: In Tünde and Stefan Zimmermann's cosy, intimate little restaurant, a very warm and friendly atmosphere awaits you, as well as flavoursome cuisine, incorporating many regional ingredients. They serve a set menu of up to seven courses. The wine list is where influences from Hungary – the owner's homeland – are particularly evident, and it is certainly worth considering her recommendations! Although located inside the building of Hotel Viktoria Eden, the restaurant is run independently....
